title: Lumen soak scenario manifest
$comment: tests/soak/scenarios.schema.json — the config plane of the soak scenario suite (card 8.C1, issue #54). Documents every manifest the suite loads: tests/soak/scenarios.toml (CI-short default), scenarios-nightly.toml (the 4 h tier driven by .github/workflows/soak-nightly.yml), scenarios-sandbox.toml (the bounded real-run profile), and any SOAK_SCENARIOS override. The Rust loader (crates/playback-engine/tests/soak_scenarios/manifest.rs) enforces the same contract at load time with loud refusals; this schema is the human/tool-facing statement of the shape for review and future CI wiring (the regression-guard wiring gap is recorded in docs/soak/soak-report-20261110.md §6.2).

schema.$comment: manifest shape version; the loader accepts only 1 (the boundaries.toml manifest-version discipline).

scenario.$comment: the scenario list, executed in file order; ids must be unique (loader-refused).

sample_ms.$comment: memory-sampling cadence (RSS + live bytes), the SOAK_SAMPLE_MS discipline.

warmup_fraction.$comment: share of each scenario excluded from the slope fit; the loader also enforces min 1 s and at least one completed cycle.

min_cycles.$comment: liveness floor: fewer completed cycles fails the scenario (D-6).

max_skip_rate.$comment: maximum share of ops skipped for state reasons (seek-storm).

leak_ceiling_mb_per_h.$comment: the ASSERTED live-bytes slope ceiling; generous default (the tests/soak 50 MB/h precedent), tightened per profile.

target_mb_per_h.$comment: the design target [PROPOSAL until the first real 4 h measurement]; reported always, asserted only where assert_target = true.

assert_target.$comment: true makes target_mb_per_h an asserted budget (the nightly tier) rather than a reported aspiration.

rss_growth_budget_mb.$comment: count-driven scenarios: allowed VmRSS growth, post-warmup baseline → final sample.

fd_growth_budget.$comment: count-driven scenarios: allowed growth in open file descriptors (/proc/self/fd; None off-Linux is reported as not-measurable).

live_growth_budget_bytes.$comment: count-driven scenarios: allowed counting-allocator live-bytes growth after the final close, post-warmup baseline.

id.$comment: stable scenario id (report keys, future quarantine references); unique across the manifest.

kind.$comment: selects the runner; the loader requires duration_min for the duration kinds and cycles for the count kinds.

duration_min.$comment: REQUIRED for play-loop/seek-storm/playlist-cycle (real wall minutes, fractional legal). OPTIONAL wall-clock cap for the count kinds: the scenario stops early and reports the shortfall honestly.

cycles.$comment: REQUIRED for open-close-churn/reopen-stress: the N of the N open→(play→)close cycles.

fixtures.$comment: paths under tests/fixtures/ (rotation for play-loop/seek-storm, playlist order for playlist-cycle, rotation for the count kinds); existence-checked at load.

advance_polls.$comment: seek-storm: engine polls between seeks (0 = seek back-to-back).
